population: Lifelines western-European unrelated adults selected for GWAS, oldest family members preferred; n=2921 eligible; excludes self-reported diabetes or FPG>=7.0 mmol/L, significant anemia, and missing HbA1c/erythrocytes/FPG. Table 2 row-specific n unknown; Table 3 complete-case n unresolved. Monte Carlo reconstruction: assumed rounded normal age on 18-95 and independent female probability 0.597; 6000 fictional rows, not source IPD.

measurement.description: Generated age years, BMI kg/m^2, glucose mg/dL and HbA1c percent are passed unchanged to fixed operators. Published units are normalized in admitted evidence; identity here does not verify assay, plasma/serum or survey-estimator equivalence.

checks.reason: Uses the assumed source age/sex distribution and shared Gaussian conditional rule; nominal Lifelines moments/projections are population inputs, while finite sampling, integer ages and eligibility truncation can change realized statistics. Unknown source support, family selection and row-specific regression n remain unresolved.
